other_conditions: The unit must have installed pollution control equipment.
Assistance is granted based on expenditure incurred and eligible assets created for installing pollution control equipment as specified by the Pondicherry Pollution Control Committee.
The unit must provide at least 60% of its employment to residents of the Union Territory of Puducherry.
The 60% local employment ratio must be maintained for the period specified in the affidavit.

The industrial unit must not transfer or dispose of the fixed asset (including plant and machinery) for five years from the date of submitting the application/disbursement of the subsidy, whichever is later.
Units that commenced commercial production on or after 1‑4‑2017 are considered new industries; units that commenced production before that date are considered existing units.

If two or more industrial undertakings are set up by the same proprietor, common partners, or common board of directors/shareholders, they are eligible as separate entities provided the locations differ and licenses/clearances/registrations are obtained separately.

Application deadline for new units: within one year from the date of commencement of commercial production; for existing units: within one year of completion of expansion/diversification/modernization.
benefits_summary: Provides a 25% subsidy on pollution control equipment up to ₹5,00,000 per unit.
